def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    months = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    stock_prices = [150, 155, 147, 160, 166]

    # Calculate the least-squares slope
    n = len(months)
    sum_x = sum(months)
    sum_y = sum(stock_prices)
    sum_xy = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(months, stock_prices))
    sum_x_squared = sum(x ** 2 for x in months)

    slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x_squared - sum_x ** 2)

    # Return the slope rounded to two decimal places
    return round(slope, 2)
